125: Only now - The question is directed to Rav Yehuda, who stated 'if he wanted he could have claimed (said) I purchased it [that is why] it is is in my possession (hand)':
Here also [is it possible] that he is believed - Do the Rabbis enact a matter that will lead to such deceit:
The Rabbis instituted that the landowner pays (gives) the taxes - to the king:
And digs the trenches - Digs the ditch around the borders:
